en.runtime.title: Runtime Memory
en.runtime.description: Compact memory carried into every turn, kept as USER.md and MEMORY.md.
en.runtime.noMatch: No runtime memory matches the current scope and query.
en.runtime.addDescription: Carried into every turn; keep long-term knowledge in Memory Spaces.
en.runtime.placeholder: Enter one compact, self-contained fact that will remain useful…
en.runtime.target.user.description: Identity, habits and working preferences; kept local only.
en.runtime.target.memory.description: Project facts, conventions and lessons; archived to Memory Spaces by topic when full.
en.runtime.branchesPlaceholder: e.g. main, dev (comma-separated; empty = visible on all branches)
